Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab (DCS) is a professional medical organization that serves as the foundational and professional anchor for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) [^src1]. Its primary significance in the Danish healthcare system lies in its central role in securing high treatment quality and standardizing clinical efforts for patients suffering from atrial fibrillation [^src1]. 

By formally anchoring the AFDK, Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab provides the necessary clinical governance and professional framework for the database's quality development initiatives [^src2]. This structural relationship ensures that interdisciplinary and intersectoral programs—such as the implementation of structured patient education and evidence-based treatment protocols—are professionally grounded and consistently applied across Danish hospital departments [^src2].
